summary: Isso is a self-hosted commenting server designed as an alternative to proprietary third-party embedding services like Disqus. It allows you to integrate comment sections into static sites or blogs using a combination of a Python backend and JavaScript frontend. Users can post comments, which are stored and served directly from your own infrastructure.
goodFor: It is a good fit if you want to remove third-party tracking from your personal blog and prefer managing your own discussion threads.
watchOut: The project sees slower maintenance activity, which may impact how quickly future security patches or compatibility updates are released.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this using Docker, ensuring you attach a persistent volume for the SQLite database storage and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
